description: This file defines data structures and methods for handling DNS SVCB and HTTPS resource records, including serialization, deserialization, and parameter management.

classes.name: SVCBResource
classes.description: Represents an SVCB DNS resource record with priority, target, and parameters.

classes.name: HTTPSResource
classes.description: Represents an HTTPS DNS resource record, an alias for SVCBResource.

classes.name: SVCParam
classes.description: Represents a service parameter key-value pair.

classes.name: SVCParamKey
classes.description: Type for SVCB parameter keys, with predefined constants.

methods.name: realType
methods.description: Returns the resource type (SVCB or HTTPS).

methods.name: GoString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the resource.

methods.name: GetParam
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value by key.

methods.name: SetParam
methods.description: Sets a parameter value by key, maintaining sorted order.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the SVCBResource into wire format.

methods.name: unpackSVCBResource
methods.description: Deserializes wire format into an SVCBResource.

methods.name: genericSVCBResource
methods.description: Adds an SVCB-like resource to a DNS message builder.

methods.name: SVCBResource
methods.description: Adds a single SVCBResource to a DNS message.

methods.name: HTTPSResource
methods.description: Adds a single HTTPSResource to a DNS message.

methods.name: SVCBResource
methods.description: Parses a single SVCBResource from a DNS message parser.

methods.name: HTTPSResource
methods.description: Parses a single HTTPSResource from a DNS message parser.
